method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Bank of America fined $1.2 billion over money-laundering violations
Equities.summary: The action by the Treasury Department was announced less than a day before Bank of America reports quarterly earnings.
Equities.reason: Large regulatory fine for a major bank ahead of earnings raises downside risk for US financials and could weigh on broader market sentiment around bank earnings.

Equities.title: Chip stocks slide after Broadcom boss warns of ‘casino’ mentality in AI investing
Equities.summary: Declines for Samsung and SK Hynix drag Korea’s Kospi sharply lower as investors fret over the scale of AI investment
Equities.reason: Executive warning from Broadcom hits the core AI/chip investment thesis, prompting sector-wide risk-off and amplifying concerns about AI-led market leadership — high market relevance.

Equities.title: Nasdaq ends down as chipmakers fall and bank earnings roll in
Equities.reason: Market-close headline tying chip weakness and bank earnings into a broader pullback in equity benchmarks — reinforces the intraday risk-off and earnings-watch narrative.

Equities.title: Anthropic urges court in Washington, D.C. to rehear appeal of Pentagon blacklisting
Equities.summary: Anthropic is asking a federal court in Washington, D.C. to rehear its appeal in a case concerning the Pentagon's blacklisting of the company's AI models.
Equities.reason: Legal and national-security scrutiny of a major AI player increases policy/regulatory risk for the AI trade and tech sector valuations.

Equities.title: Anthropic to disclose new revenue numbers as AI lab financials become central to tech trade
Equities.summary: Anthropic will release updated financials to a group of investors gathering at its headquarters this week, according to people familiar with the matter.
Equities.reason: Heightened focus on private AI lab finances tightens scrutiny on AI business models — could be a catalyst for re-rating if numbers disappoint.

Equities.title: The AI trade is cracking. Here's how to profit
Equities.summary: Despite the Magnificent Seven making record highs, the The AI trade is showing signs of cracks. But there may be an opportunity for traders.
Equities.reason: Explicit note that the AI-led rally is showing cracks points to a changing market regime (leadership rotation/risk-off) and is relevant for positioning across tech-heavy indices.

Equities.title: Paul Tudor Jones says 2027 could be a really challenging year for the stock market
Equities.summary: The billionaire investor said that corporate buybacks, along with mergers and acquisitions, that have been a tail wind for the bull market are about to turn.
Equities.reason: Prominent investor warning about structural tailwinds (buybacks/M&A) reversing increases downside risk sentiment for equities and could influence allocation decisions.

Equities.title: Apple releases HomeView smart home hub with screen as showcase for Siri AI
Equities.summary: The iPhone maker also announced the new Apple TV 4K and HomePod Mini.
Equities.reason: New Apple hardware showcasing Siri AI supports the secular AI/product cycle narrative and can underpin positive investor interest in large-cap tech names.

Equities.title: JPMorgan Chase blocks outside AI agents like Muse, Instinct from directly accessing accounts
Equities.summary: JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon warned of rogue agents operating at scale and said the bank is building defensive tools.
Equities.reason: Bank-level operational controls on AI reduce one idiosyncratic risk but also signal friction between AI adoption and regulated financial-services operations — modest negative for AI hype.

Equities.title: FBI arrests Saudi OpenAI employee who allegedly planted recording device in conference room
Equities.summary: The Tuesday incident comes as the ChatGPT-maker, along with competitors, faces heightened scrutiny over its safety practices.
Equities.reason: Security breach/arrest tied to a major AI lab heightens safety and governance concerns that can pressure AI-related valuations and investor risk appetite.

Equities.title: Why this little known Chinese chipmaker has caused a global stock rout
Equities.summary: China's leading memory chipmaker CXMT has reportedly made progress on new designs.
Equities.reason: Shock from a Chinese chipmaker’s progress and ensuing rout feeds into semiconductor sector fears and global investor reassessment of supply/competition for memory — sector-wide impact.

Equities.title: Ships in Hormuz strait hit by worst spate of attacks since start of war
Equities.summary: Twenty-four tankers and other vessels targeted by Iran in two weeks, including six on Sunday alone
Equities.reason: Escalating attacks in a major shipping choke point raise geopolitical risk, likely to spur risk-off flows and affect cyclicals, energy and transport-exposed equities.

Rates.title: Investors brave US Treasury rout to lock in highest yields in decades
Rates.summary: Government bond funds are attracting record inflows as borrowing costs hit their highest level in decades
Rates.reason: Direct rates story: describes a Treasury sell-off / 'rout' and the move to record-high yields. Negative for bond prices (yields up). High relevance since it signals a broad regime of higher-for-longer yields and large investor flows into bond funds.

Rates.title: Fed’s Barkin says persistent inflation warrants policy action
Rates.summary: On Tuesday, Richmond Federal Reserve (Fed) President Thomas Barkin appeared at Howard University and said 2 percent inflation isn't a unicorn and that “we can hit it,” adding that Fed policymakers see the impact of AI investment on US inflation.
Rates.reason: Policy-maker comments highlighting persistent inflation and need for action push rate-hike expectations and higher yields — negative for bonds. Relevant as part of the Fed hawkish narrative.

Rates.title: Fed's Collins backs September hike, sees Oil and AI driving inflation
Rates.summary: On Tuesday, Boston Federal Reserve (Fed) President Susan Collins said that the Fed's main focus is inflation, while adding that he expects "inflation to stay above 2% due to high energy prices.”
Rates.reason: Another Fed official endorsing hikes and citing upside inflation drivers — reinforces hawkish Fed expectations and upward pressure on yields (negative for bond prices). Moderate relevance as a confirmatory signal.

Rates.title: Williams says Fed may not have to hike rates in 2027, at odds with traders
Rates.summary: New York Fed President John Williams sees one more rate hike in 2026 but no additional increase in 2027 as inflation pressures ease.
Rates.reason: Fed voter signalling one more hike this year keeps near-term rate expectations elevated (negative for bonds). Slightly higher relevance because Williams is a key FOMC voter and his view affects market pricing.

Rates.title: Swiss Franc strengthens on dovish Fed rhetoric as US CPI looms
Rates.summary: The Swiss Franc (CHF) registers gains versus the US Dollar (USD) on Tuesday as risk appetite improves and energy prices retreat, weighing on the Greenback, which failed to advance even as US Treasury yields soared ahead of the US CPI release. The USD/CHF pair
Rates.reason: Notes that US Treasury yields 'soared' ahead of CPI — direct reference to a bond selloff. Included for rates as an FX piece that explicitly cites Treasury yield moves; relevance is moderate (secondary FX angle).

Rates.title: Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee, September 15-16, 2026
Rates.summary: Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee, September 15-16, 2026
Rates.reason: FOMC minutes are a primary source for policy intent and near-term rate path. Treated as net-hawkish here given the surrounding Fed commentary and market pricing; significant relevance for rates markets.

Rates.title: Minutes of the Board's discount rate meetings on August 17, September 9, and September 16, 2026
Rates.summary: Minutes of the Board's discount rate meetings on August 17, September 9, and September 16, 2026
Rates.reason: Discount rate meeting minutes provide additional operational/policy insight into Fed stance. Leaning negative for rates as they add to the ensemble of Fed communications supporting higher-for-longer expectations; moderate relevance.

Rates.title: BNY, Citadel Securities test tokenized U.S. Treasuries to speed up Wall Street financing
Rates.reason: Market-structure story about tokenizing Treasuries that could improve settlement and financing efficiency. Mildly positive for the functioning/liquidity of the Treasury market (small positive for rates), but low-to-moderate relevance for immediate yield direction.

Rates.title: Thousands of homeowners face adjustable-rate mortgage resets — and much higher payments
Rates.summary: Adjustable-rate mortgages with low introductory interest rates are facing their first adjustment at a time when rates are much higher, according to new data.
Rates.reason: Real-economy transmission of higher rates: large ARMs resetting to much higher payments highlights the economic impact of elevated rates and reinforces the higher-for-longer narrative (negative for bond prices via default/credit and growth channels).

FX.title: Neither a breakout nor a reversal: What OCBC, Commerzbank and ING expect from the US Dollar
FX.summary: Three banks agree the US Dollar (USD) is on solid footing for now, but none expects a decisive breakout or a sharp reversal soon. OCBC, Commerzbank and ING credit the Greenback's support to higher Oil prices, firm US yields and sticky Federal Reserve (Fed) tig
FX.reason: Multi-bank thematic: three institutional views pointing to USD on solid footing driven by oil, firm US yields and sticky Fed expectations. USD-strength narrative is meaningful for G10 FX (negative for non-USD currencies), so high relevance.

FX.title: Yen trails the majors as the BoJ is said to lean against a hike
FX.summary: The Dollar fell against every major currency on Tuesday and fell least against the Yen, on the day the Bank of Japan (BoJ) was reported to be leaning against an October rate hike.
FX.reason: BoJ reportedly leaning against a hike is a dovish signal for JPY; market observed USD fell versus majors but fell least vs JPY, implying relative JPY weakness. Clear USD/JPY transmission, single-day but FX-native—moderate relevance.

FX.title: Japanese Yen: Choppy trade after JPY-supportive comments – Scotiabank
FX.summary: Scotiabank strategists Shaun Osborne and Eric Theoret highlight the Japanese Yen (JPY) as somewhat firmer, with USD/JPY pulling back from the upper 158s on comments from BoJ Governor Ueda and PM Takaichi about close US-Japan FX contact.
FX.reason: Official JPY-supportive comments and talk of close US–Japan FX contact are explicit FX transmission and can underpin JPY strength (USD weakness). This reinforces an intervention/coordination narrative—meaningful for JPY moves.

FX.title: US Dollar: Fed pricing leg looks stretched – Societe Generale
FX.summary: Societe Generale’s Kit Juckes argues that Fed Funds forward pricing may be nearing the end of its third upward leg this year, with current expectations just below 5% and the US Dollar (USD) having risen alongside each repricing.
FX.reason: Macro-rate narrative: if Fed pricing is near the end of hikes, the USD’s repricing-driven rally may be exhausted — a material upside catalyst for non-USD currencies. Broad-market implication for FX, hence higher relevance.

FX.title: Euro finds support from softer US Dollar, French fiscal risks linger
FX.summary: EUR/USD gains ground on Tuesday as the US Dollar (USD) retreats from recent highs, giving the Euro (EUR) some breathing room despite persistent concerns over France’s fiscal and political outlook. At the time of writing, the pair trades around 1.1192, up 0.33%
FX.reason: Market-level move: USD retreat is supporting EUR despite idiosyncratic French fiscal risks. Direct USD→EUR transmission with intraday price action — meaningful for EUR/USD positioning.

FX.title: Chinese Yuan: Outlook stays mildly positive against US Dollar – UOB
FX.summary: United Overseas Bank (UOB) strategists Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann describe USD/CNH price action as fading in downside momentum and now largely range-bound between 6.6900 and 6.7000 in the short term. Over 1–3 weeks, they still warn that a break and close b
FX.reason: Single-bank outlook: UOB sees mildly positive CNH vs USD and short-term range-bound action. Relevant for EM/Asia FX flows but lower relevance as it's a bank note rather than a market-moving policy shock.

FX.title: Singapore Dollar: Priced-in MAS move limits gains against US Dollar - OCBC
FX.summary: OCBC strategists Sim Moh Siong and Christopher Wong expect Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) to slightly steepen its S$NEER policy band slope on Wednesday. With tightening largely priced in, the immediate Singapore Dollar (SGD) reaction may be muted.
FX.reason: Policy expectation priced into S$NEER limits upside for SGD vs USD; FX-native but localized and already priced, so low-to-moderate relevance.

FX.title: Pound gains as Fed's Williams sees no 2027 hike
FX.summary: Despite Tuesday's gain, GBP/USD is in its third straight week of trading between roughly 1.3200 and 1.3300, a range it has held since September 24. It climbed in steps from just above 1.3200 to a high just under 1.3260 and trades near 1.3250, the middle of tha
FX.reason: Fed commentary (Williams) reducing odds of further hikes pushes USD softer and GBP/USD higher. Clear USD-driven FX move with regional significance for GBP — moderate-high relevance.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar: Modest gains against US Dollar - Scotiabank
FX.summary: Scotiabank strategists Shaun Osborne and Eric Theoret reports the Canadian Dollar (CAD) up 0.2% versus the US Dollar (USD) but underperforming other G10 currencies, with markets still pricing Bank of Canada (BoC) tightening into year-end despite weak labour da
FX.reason: CAD showing modest upside vs USD amid BoC tightening priced in — direct FX impact but small move and somewhat idiosyncratic, so limited relevance.

Commodities.title: Gold struggles to reclaim $4,200 as Fed interest rate hike risks persist, US CPI looms
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) reverses earlier gains on Tuesday as US Treasury yields recover after falling earlier in the day. With the US Dollar (USD) still under pressure, the metal trades little changed during American trading hours.
Commodities.reason: Gold reacting to Treasury yield dynamics and Fed-rate risk ahead of CPI; yields recovering weigh on non-yielding gold. Mid-strength market relevance given macro data focus but contains balanced USD/yield signals.

Commodities.title: Gold slides on US yields surge ahead of CPI
Commodities.summary: Gold price (XAU/USD) extends its losses on Tuesday as US Treasury yields resumed their uptrend, erasing previous losses, even though the US Dollar faces headwinds ahead of the release of US inflation data. At the time of writing, XAU/USD trades at $4,157, down
Commodities.reason: Strong negative transmission: rising US yields and hawkish Fed expectations ahead of CPI are a clear price headwind for gold. Higher relevance due to immediate macro impulse and market-moving US data context.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD struggles near two-month lows ahead of US CPI
Commodities.summary: Silver (XAG/USD) trades on the back foot on Tuesday, losing more than 1.5% as hawkish Federal Reserve (Fed) expectations and elevated US Treasury yields weigh on the non-yielding metal.
Commodities.reason: Silver, like gold, is being driven lower by rising US yields and hawkish Fed pricing; silver's higher beta to macro moves gives a sizable negative directional score and above-average relevance ahead of CPI.

Commodities.title: Mixed outlook for energy expenditures this winter
Commodities.summary: We expect energy expenditures this winter to vary because of diverging trends in energy prices among fuels and regional variation in forecast temperatures. We expect that lower prices for natural gas and propane will drive decreases in expenditures this year f
Commodities.reason: EIA expects lower natural gas (and propane) prices this winter, a price-weakness signal for the natural gas commodity. Moderate relevance as seasonal forecast from a primary statistics source informs forward price expectations.

Commodities.title: Category 2 Hurricane Isaias nears landfall, leading to production shut-ins
Commodities.summary: As of 4:00 a.m. central time on October 9, the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration expects Hurricane Isaias to make landfall on the Gulf Coast late Friday or early Saturday, creating the potential for significant disruptions to energy infrastructur
Commodities.reason: Imminent Gulf Coast hurricane risk implies potential crude production and refinery shut-ins — a clear short-term supply shock for WTI and refined products. High relevance given direct physical disruption to US hydrocarbon infrastructure.

Commodities.title: Crude oil prices and refinery margins generally increased throughout the third quarter
Commodities.summary: Petroleum markets in the third quarter of 2026 (3Q26) were characterized by increasing prices for crude oil and petroleum products amid persistent conflict in the Middle East.
Commodities.reason: EIA summary points to firm Q3 crude and margin strength driven by Middle East conflict — supportive fundamental backdrop for oil prices. Solid relevance as an authoritative market-energy overview reinforcing supply-risk narrative.

Commodities.title: Paul Tudor Jones is bullish on oil, says it could rally another $20-$25 because of Iran conflict
Commodities.reason: Prominent investor call linking Iran conflict to a sizable upside in oil prices. Adds sentiment/leverage to existing geopolitical supply-risk narrative; included for market psychology though it's opinion-based so relevance is moderate.

Crypto.title: Russia’s largest bank Sberbank secures approval to trade crypto
Crypto.reason: Major regional bank approval expands institutional access and on‑ramp for crypto in Russia — positive adoption/integration signal for the asset class.

Crypto.title: South Korea blocks 27 crypto exchanges, including Bitmart and Kucoin
Crypto.reason: Large-scale regulatory action restricting exchange access in a major market raises counterparty and access risk, likely negative for flows and sentiment.

Crypto.title: Ledger says 'spy' chip inside CryptoBilis Ledger devices transmitted wallet keys over mobile network
Crypto.reason: Hardware‑wallet security breach undermines trust in self‑custody and could drive withdrawals, regulatory scrutiny and reputational damage across custodians.

Crypto.title: Ledger claims CryptoBilis cases are limited as up to $93 million is traced, $10 million frozen
Crypto.reason: Follow‑up mitigation: tracing and freezing funds reduces net impact of the Ledger/CryptoBilis incident and partially restores confidence — limited positive offset to the breach.

Crypto.title: UK court ruling boosts government’s chances of keeping $5 billion in seized bitcoin
Crypto.reason: Court precedent strengthening government claims on seized crypto raises legal/regulatory risk for holders and custodians, negative for trust and potential flows.

Crypto.title: Global financial watchdog calls for cross-border information sharing, planning for stablecoin crisis
Crypto.reason: Coordinated regulatory planning for stablecoin crises increases system resilience and could reduce tail‑risk; constructive for long‑term institutional adoption.

Crypto.title: South Korea just got its first traditional bank loans backed by bitcoin
Crypto.reason: Traditional banks extending bitcoin‑backed loans is a material step toward mainstream financial integration and liquidity channels — positive adoption signal.

Crypto.title: Tom Lee sees $2 trillion wealth transfer fueling crypto demand as Bitmine buys more ether
Crypto.reason: Prominent analyst/institutional buy thesis pointing to large structural demand supports bullish narrative for crypto inflows and allocation shifts.

Crypto.title: Standard Chartered offers RLUSD custody in Dubai and plans LMAX collateral link
Crypto.reason: Major bank expanding stablecoin custody and collateral plumbing in a key regional hub — supports institutional infrastructure and market depth.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin falls below $83,000 as dollar strength keeps markets on edge
Crypto.reason: Macro FX (USD) strength is weighing on risk assets including crypto; dollar‑driven pressure is a meaningful headwind for short‑term crypto performance.

Crypto.title: Tokenized SanDisk bets saw more liquidations than XRP as Asia’s chip rout wipes out $800 million
Crypto.reason: Shows leverage and tokenized‑asset contagion from an equity sector rout; highlights systemic leverage/liquidity risks in crypto derivatives markets.

Crypto.title: Once-largest Ethereum NFT marketplace Blur is shutting down after volumes collapse 99%
Crypto.reason: Major NFT marketplace closure underscores ongoing contraction in the NFT sector and reduced activity/liquidity for that segment of crypto.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin whale that sat through the March 2020 crash moves $378 million
Crypto.reason: Large on‑chain whale movement is a potential signal of re‑allocation or distribution and increases short‑term volatility risk.
